public_rationale: Both named components hold on the ordinary product-level reading. Rabbit placed public Teach Mode release after launch, and a contemporary review still described it as a future upgrade. Two independent reviewers documented repeated failures in advertised ride-booking and food-ordering actions. Successful demonstrations, music playback and image generation show that some actions worked, but do not establish dependable operation. The evidence supports launch-time unavailability and unreliability; it does not establish that no LAM existed.
limitations: Reliability is assessed qualitatively from firsthand launch reviews, not a controlled benchmark.
The finding concerns the delivered action-taking experience, not a diagnosis of the underlying model.
Prelaunch documentation is context; the launch-period review corroborates Teach Mode's absence.
Subsequent product improvements are outside the target period.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The Rabbit R1 launched without key features, including Teach Mode and a stable, reliable version of its Large Action Model.

statement.excerpt: And all of this is deeply relevant at a time when Rabbit’s R1 device has launched without several key features, such as “Teach Mode” and a stable, reliable version of its alleged “Large Action Model.”

from_speaker: has launched without several key features
a stable, reliable version of its alleged “Large Action Model.”
our_interpretation: Launch means the initial consumer release in April 2024, assessed through the May 6 post. The target period begins at the month boundary because the claim supplies no launch day.
Teach Mode being absent means ordinary buyers could not use it. A demonstration or restricted test does not establish general availability.

Stable and reliable means advertised service actions worked dependably in ordinary use. Repeated failures to complete basic supported tasks count against reliability; occasional successes do not establish it.
The LAM wording concerns the delivered action-taking experience. It does not require proving that no underlying model existed or identifying which component caused each failure.
The two named features define the checkable scope. No additional numerical requirement is inferred from 'several'.
criteria.support_condition: Launch documentation and contemporary testing establish that Teach Mode was unavailable to ordinary buyers and that advertised LAM service actions repeatedly failed in ordinary use.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that Teach Mode was available to ordinary buyers at launch and that advertised LAM actions worked consistently in ordinary use. If only one named component is established and the other is refuted, the result is mixed.
